issues.title: Text item is not highlight when it's selected from 'Items' panel
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Now all item types are highlight when it's selected on 'Items' panel except 'Text' item. Text item should be highligh as another item types

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Draw a 'Text' item
4. Select this item on left panel
5. Notice 'Text' item is not highlight

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Text item should be highlight when it's selected from 'Items' panel

## 🖥️ Screenshots

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/5fcf21f2-6cdb-4fdc-a0fd-fa9018fde1df



## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
